15: # Time Derivatives
16: 
17: ## i. Overview
18: 
19: In this module we define and prove basic lemmas about derivatives of functions on `Time`.
20: 
21: ## ii. Key results
22: 
23: - `deriv` : The derivative of a function `Time → M` at a given time.
24: - `manifoldDeriv` : The derivative of a function from `Time` to a manifold.
25: 
26: ## iii. Table of contents
27: 
28: - A. The definition of the derivative
29:   - A.1. Derivatives of functions into vector spaces
30:   - A.2. Derivatives of functions into manifolds
31: - B. Linearlity properties of the derivative
32: - C. Derivative of constant functions
33: - D. Smoothness properties
34: - E. Derivatives of components
35:

37:

40: @[expose] public section

42: namespace Time

48: ## A. The definition of the derivative
49: 
50: -/
51: 
52: /-!
53: 
54: ### A.1. Derivatives of functions into vector spaces
55: 
56: -/
57: 
58: /-- Given a function `f : Time → M` the derivative of `f`. -/
59: noncomputable def deriv [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M] [TopologicalSpace M]
60:     (f : Time → M) : Time → M :=
61:   (fun t => fderiv ℝ f t 1)
62: 
63: @[inherit_doc deriv]
64: scoped notation "∂ₜ" => deriv
65: 
66: lemma deriv_eq [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M] [TopologicalSpace M]
67:     (f : Time → M) (t : Time) : Time.deriv f t = fderiv ℝ f t 1 := rfl
68: 
69: /-!
70: 
71: ### A.2. Derivatives of functions into manifolds
72: 
73: -/
74: 
75: open Manifold in
76: /-- The time derivative of a function from `Time` to a manifold, as a tangent vector at
77: the value of the function. -/
78: noncomputable def manifoldDeriv {E H N : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
79:     [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) [TopologicalSpace N]
80:     [ChartedSpace H N] (f : Time → N) : (t : Time) → TangentSpace I (f t) :=
81:   fun t => mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, Time) I f t ((1 : Time) : TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, Time) t)
82: 
83: open Manifold in
84: lemma manifoldDeriv_eq {E H N : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
85:     [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) [TopologicalSpace N]
86:     [ChartedSpace H N] (f : Time → N) (t : Time) :
87:     manifoldDeriv I f t =
88:       mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, Time) I f t ((1 : Time) : TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, Time) t) := rfl
89: 
90: open Manifold in
91: /-- The time derivative is the manifold derivative for functions into normed spaces. -/
92: lemma deriv_eq_mfderiv [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M]
93:     (f : Time → M) (t : Time) :
94:     deriv f t =
95:       mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, Time) 𝓘(ℝ, M) f t
96:         ((1 : Time) : TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, Time) t) := by
97:   rw [deriv_eq, ← mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
98:   rfl
99: 
100: open Manifold in
101: lemma deriv_eq_manifoldDeriv [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M]
102:     (f : Time → M) (t : Time) :
103:     deriv f t = manifoldDeriv 𝓘(ℝ, M) f t := by
104:   rw [deriv_eq_mfderiv, manifoldDeriv_eq]
105: 
106: open Manifold in
107: @[simp]
108: lemma manifoldDeriv_const {E H N : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
109:     [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) [TopologicalSpace N]
110:     [ChartedSpace H N] (n : N) :
111:     manifoldDeriv I (fun _ : Time => n) t = 0 := by
112:   simp [manifoldDeriv]
113: 
114: /-!

116: ## B. Linearlity properties of the derivative
117: 
118: -/
119: 
120: lemma deriv_smul (f : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (k : ℝ)
121:     (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) :
122:     ∂ₜ (fun t => k • f t) t = k • ∂ₜ (fun t => f t) t := by
123:   rw [deriv, fderiv_fun_const_smul]
124:   rfl
125:   fun_prop
126: 
127: lemma deriv_neg [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] (f : Time → M) :
128:     ∂ₜ (-f) t = -∂ₜ f t := by
129:   rw [deriv, fderiv_neg]
130:   rfl
131: 
132: lemma deriv_add [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] (f g : Time → M)
133:     (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f t) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g t) :
134:     ∂ₜ (fun s => f s + g s) t = ∂ₜ f t + ∂ₜ g t := by
135:   simp only [Time.deriv_eq]
136:   rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hg, _root_.add_apply]
137: 
138: lemma deriv_fun_sum {ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M]
139:     (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → Time → M) (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ (a i) t) :
140:     ∂ₜ (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, a i x) t = ∑ i ∈ s, ∂ₜ (a i) t := by
141:   simp only [Time.deriv_eq]
142:   rw [fderiv_fun_sum ha, _root_.sum_apply]
143: 
144: lemma deriv_mul_const (f : Time → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f t) :
145:     ∂ₜ (fun s => f s * c) t = ∂ₜ f t * c := by
146:   simp only [Time.deriv_eq]
147:   rw [fderiv_mul_const hf c, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

149: /-- Quotient rule for `Time.deriv` on real-valued functions: if `c` and `g` are
150:   differentiable at `t` and `g t ≠ 0`, then
151:   `∂ₜ (c / g) t = (∂ₜ c t * g t - c t * ∂ₜ g t) / (g t)^2`. -/
152: lemma deriv_div {c g : Time → ℝ}
153:     (hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ c t) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g t) (hgz : g t ≠ 0) :
154:     ∂ₜ (fun s => c s / g s) t =
155:       (∂ₜ c t * g t - c t * ∂ₜ g t) / (g t) ^ 2 := by
156:   repeat rw [Time.deriv_eq]
157:   ring_nf
158:   simp [fderiv_fun_mul hc (DifferentiableAt.fun_inv (by fun_prop) hgz),

160:   field_simp

63: ## A. Derivatives of functions on `Space d`
64: 
65: -/
66: 
67: /-- Given a function `f : Space d → M` the derivative of `f` in direction `μ`. -/
68: noncomputable def deriv {M d} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M] [TopologicalSpace M]
69:     (μ : Fin d) (f : Space d → M) : Space d → M :=
70:   (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x (basis μ))
71: 
72: @[inherit_doc deriv]
73: macro "∂[" i:term "]" : term => `(deriv $i)
74: 
75: /-!
76: 
77: ### A.1. Basic equalities
78: 
79: -/
80: 
81: lemma deriv_eq [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M] [TopologicalSpace M]
82:     (μ : Fin d) (f : Space d → M) (x : Space d) :
83:     deriv μ f x = fderiv ℝ f x (basis μ) := by rfl
84: 
85: lemma deriv_eq_fderiv_fun [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M] [TopologicalSpace M]
86:     (μ : Fin d) (f : Space d → M) :
87:     deriv μ f = fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun x => f x) x (basis μ) := by rfl
88: 
89: lemma deriv_eq_fderiv_basis [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M] [TopologicalSpace M]
90:     (μ : Fin d) (f : Space d → M) (x : Space d) :
91:     deriv μ f x = fderiv ℝ f x (basis μ) := by rfl
92: 
93: lemma fderiv_eq_sum_deriv {M d} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M] [TopologicalSpace M]
94:     (f : Space d → M) (x y : Space d) :
95:     fderiv ℝ f x y = ∑ i : Fin d, y i • ∂[i] f x := by
96:   conv_lhs => rw [← basis.sum_repr y]
97:   simp [deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
98: 
99: open Manifold in
100: /-- The spatial-derivative in terms of the derivative of functions between
101:   manifolds. -/
102: lemma deriv_eq_mfderiv {M d} [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M]
103:     (μ : Fin d) (f : Space d → M) (x : Space d) :
104:     deriv μ f x = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, Space d) 𝓘(ℝ, M) f x (basis μ) := by
105:   rw [deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, ← mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
106:   rfl
107: 
108: open Manifold in
109: lemma mdifferentiable_manifoldStructure_iff_differentiable {M d} [NormedAddCommGroup M]
110:     [NormedSpace ℝ M] {f : Space d → M} {x : Space d} :
111:     MDifferentiableAt (𝓡 d) 𝓘(ℝ, M) f x ↔ DifferentiableAt ℝ f x := by
112:   refine ⟨fun h => mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.mp <| h.comp (I' := 𝓡 d) x
113:     (modelDiffeo.symm.mdifferentiable WithTop.top_ne_zero).mdifferentiableAt,
114:     fun h => (mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.mpr h).comp (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, Space d)) x
115:       (modelDiffeo.mdifferentiable WithTop.top_ne_zero).mdifferentiableAt⟩
116:

121: open Manifold in
122: set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
123: /-- The spatial-derivative in terms of the derivative of functions between
124:   manifolds with the manifold structure `Space.manifoldStructure d`. -/
125: lemma deriv_eq_mfderiv_manifoldStructure {M d} [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M]
126:     (μ : Fin d) (f : Space d → M) (x : Space d) :
127:     deriv μ f x = mfderiv (𝓡 d) 𝓘(ℝ, M) f x (EuclideanSpace.single μ 1) := by
128:   by_cases hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x
129:   · rw [deriv_eq_mfderiv]
130:     change _ = mfderiv (𝓡 d) 𝓘(ℝ, M)
131:       (f ∘ modelDiffeo) x (EuclideanSpace.single μ 1)
132:     rw [mfderiv_comp (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, Space d)) _ hf.mdifferentiableAt
133:       (modelDiffeo.mdifferentiable WithTop.top_ne_zero).mdifferentiableAt]
134:     simp only [Function.comp_apply, modelDiffeo_apply, mfderiv_eq_fderiv,
135:       ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp]
136:     rw [basis_eq_mfderiv_modelDiffeo_single]
137:     rfl
138:   · rw [deriv_eq, fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hf,
139:       mfderiv_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableAt <|
140:       mdifferentiable_manifoldStructure_iff_differentiable.mp.mt hf]
141:     simp

145: ### A.2. Derivative of the constant function
146: 
147: -/
148: 
149: @[simp]
150: lemma deriv_const [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] (m : M) (μ : Fin d) :
151:     deriv μ (fun _ => m) t = 0 := by
152:   simp [deriv]
153: 
154: /-!
155: 
156: ### A.3. Derivative distributes over addition and subtraction
157: 
158: -/
159: 
160: /-- Derivatives on space distribute over addition. -/
161: @[to_fun]
162: lemma deriv_add [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M]
163:     (f1 f2 : Space d → M) (hf1 : Differentiable ℝ f1) (hf2 : Differentiable ℝ f2) :
164:     ∂[u] (f1 + f2) = ∂[u] f1 + ∂[u] f2 := by
165:   ext x
166:   simp [deriv_eq, fderiv_add (hf1 x) (hf2 x)]
167: 
168: /-- Derivatives on space distribute coordinate-wise over addition. -/
169: lemma deriv_coord_add (f1 f2 : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
170:     (hf1 : Differentiable ℝ f1) (hf2 : Differentiable ℝ f2) :
171:     (∂[u] (fun x => f1 x i + f2 x i)) =
172:       (∂[u] (fun x => f1 x i)) + (∂[u] (fun x => f2 x i)) :=
173:   deriv_add (fun x => f1 x i) (fun x => f2 x i) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
174: 
175: /-- Derivatives on space distribute over subtraction. -/
176: @[to_fun]
177: lemma deriv_sub [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M]
178:     (f1 f2 : Space d → M) (hf1 : Differentiable ℝ f1) (hf2 : Differentiable ℝ f2) :
179:     ∂[u] (f1 - f2) = ∂[u] f1 - ∂[u] f2 := by
180:   ext x
181:   simp [deriv_eq, fderiv_sub (hf1 x) (hf2 x)]
182: 
183: /-!
184: 
185: ### A.4. Derivative distributes over scalar multiplication
186: 
187: -/
188: 
189: /-- Space derivatives on scalar product of functions. -/
190: lemma deriv_smul [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
191:     [NormedAlgebra ℝ 𝕜] [NormedSpace 𝕜 M] {c : Space d → 𝕜} {f : Space d → M}
192:     (hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ c x) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) :
193:     ∂[u] (c • f) x = c x • ∂[u] f x + ∂[u] c x • f x := by
194:   simp [deriv_eq, fderiv_smul hc hf]
195: 
196: /-- Space derivatives on scalar times function. -/
197: lemma deriv_const_smul [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] [Semiring R]
198:     [Module R M] [SMulCommClass ℝ R M] [ContinuousConstSMul R M] {f : Space d → M} (c : R)
199:     (h : Differentiable ℝ f) : ∂[u] (c • f) = c • ∂[u] f := by
200:   ext x
201:   simp [deriv_eq, fderiv_const_smul (h x) c]
202: 
203: /-- Coordinate-wise scalar multiplication on space derivatives. -/
204: lemma deriv_coord_smul (f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (k : ℝ)
205:     (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) :
206:     ∂[u] (fun x => k * f x i) x = k * ∂[u] (fun x => f x i) x :=
207:   congrFun (deriv_const_smul (f := fun x => f x i) k (by fun_prop)) x
208: 
209: /-!
210: 
211: ### A.5. Two spatial derivatives commute
212: 
213: -/
214: 
215: /-- Derivatives on space commute with one another. -/
216: lemma deriv_commute [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M]
217:     (f : Space d → M) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) : ∂[u] (∂[v] f) = ∂[v] (∂[u] f) := by
218:   simp only [deriv_eq_fderiv_fun]
219:   ext x
220:   rw [fderiv_clm_apply, fderiv_clm_apply]
221:   simp only [fderiv_fun_const, Pi.ofNat_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_zero, zero_add,
222:     ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
223:   rw [(hf.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp)).eq]
224:   repeat fun_prop
225: 
226: /-!
227: 
228: ### A.6. Derivative of a component
229: 
230: -/
231: 
232: @[simp]
233: lemma deriv_component_same (μ : Fin d) (x : Space d) :
234:     ∂[μ] (fun x => x μ) x = 1 := by
235:   simp only [← Space.coord_apply, ← Space.coordCLM_apply]
236:   simp only [deriv_eq, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
237:   simp [Space.coordCLM, Space.coord]
238: 
239: lemma deriv_component_diff (μ ν : Fin d) (x : Space d) (h : μ ≠ ν) :
240:     (deriv μ (fun x => x ν) x) = 0 := by
241:   simp only [← Space.coord_apply, ← Space.coordCLM_apply]
242:   simp only [deriv_eq, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
243:   simpa [Space.coordCLM, Space.coord, basis_apply] using h
244: 
245: lemma deriv_component (μ ν : Fin d) (x : Space d) :
246:     (deriv ν (fun x => x μ) x) = if ν = μ then 1 else 0 := by
247:   obtain rfl | h' := eq_or_ne ν μ
248:   · simp
249:   · simp [deriv_component_diff ν μ x h', h']
250: 
251: /-!
252: 
253: ### A.7. Derivative of a component squared
254: 
255: -/
256: 
257: lemma deriv_component_sq {d : ℕ} {ν μ : Fin d} (x : Space d) :
258:     (deriv ν (fun x => (x μ) ^ 2) x) = if ν = μ then 2 * x μ else 0:= by
259:   rw [deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_pow 2 (eval_differentiable μ x)]
260:   simp [← deriv_eq, deriv_component, mul_ite]
261: 
262: /-!
263: 
264: ### A.8. Derivivatives of components
265: 
266: -/
267: 
268: lemma deriv_euclid {d ν μ} {f : Space d → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
269:     (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (x : Space d) :
270:     deriv ν (fun x => f x μ) x = deriv ν (fun x => f x) x μ := by
271:   rw [deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
272:   change fderiv ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj μ ∘ fun x => f x) x (basis ν) = _
273:   rw [fderiv_comp x (EuclideanSpace.proj μ).differentiableAt (hf x)]
274:   simp [-EuclideanSpace.coe_proj, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
275: 
276: lemma deriv_lorentz_vector {d ν μ} {f : Space d → Lorentz.Vector d}
277:     (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (x : Space d) :
278:     deriv ν (fun x => f x μ) x = deriv ν (fun x => f x) x μ := by
279:   rw [deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
280:   change fderiv ℝ (Lorentz.Vector.coordCLM μ ∘ fun x => f x) x (basis ν) = _
281:   rw [fderiv_comp x (Lorentz.Vector.coordCLM μ).differentiableAt (hf x)]
282:   simp [← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, Lorentz.Vector.coordCLM_apply]
283:

286: ### A.9. Derivative of a norm squared
287:

289:

292: #### A.9.1. Differentiability of the norm squared function

295: @[fun_prop]
296: lemma norm_sq_differentiable : Differentiable ℝ (fun x : Space d => ‖x‖ ^ 2) :=

302:

304: 
305: lemma deriv_norm_sq (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
306:     deriv i (fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2) x = 2 * x i := by
307:   simp [deriv_eq, fderiv_norm_sq_apply]

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA2 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA2 t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB := fun j : Fin d => magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A hA2 (j, i)
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB j) x t
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)
    (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i t
  have hg := funext fun y =>
    ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1
  have hdiv := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i)) hg
  unfold Space.div at hdiv
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at hdiv
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt),
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t).differentiableAt] at hdiv
  simp only [_root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, ← one_div] at hdiv
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1]
    change fun s => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) s
    enter [s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time (hA2.of_le (by decide)) x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hsum := DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun j _ => hBt j
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub (hsum.const_mul _)
      (hJt.const_mul _),
    fderiv_const_mul hsum,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt,
    fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => hBt j)]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, 2, 2, j]
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (hB j)]
    simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA2.of_le (by decide))]
    rw [Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hdiv]
  have hc : (𝓕.c : ℝ) ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ = 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ := by
    rw [FreeSpace.c_sq, ← div_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]
  rw [mul_comm 𝓕.μ₀ 𝓕.ε₀, ← FreeSpace.c_sq]
  simp only [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, ← div_eq_mul_one_div, hc]
